subject: Owners' roadmap, QBR readiness and charter sign-off
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Maria Gonzales <maria.g@acme.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Owners' roadmap, QBR readiness and charter sign-off

Team / Maria —

Sharing the working draft of the owners' roadmap and the objective matrix for Q1. Goal here is twofold: (1) lock owners + success metrics by EOD Thursday, 18 Feb, so we can include the finalized pages in the QBR packet; (2) complete the commercial readiness checklist with Acme ahead of the account exec review next week.

Attachments: Q1_objective_matrix_v1.xlsx; owners-roadmap_v0_3.pdf

Key asks (short):
- Laura: confirm who from Sales Ops will be primary approver for the revenue-related KR and confirm the final quota mapping.
- Vivek: review the latency/cost KRs for inference routing and flag any SRE or Runtime risks.
- Karthik: please check the cross-org dependencies and call out blockers for Private deployment customers (security review slot needed).
- Maria / Acme: confirm the target launch date and any additional procurement steps we should anticipate.

I'll consolidate decisions into the charter doc and send a final sign-off thread. If agreeable, I'll generate a DocuSign signature request for the commercial annex (link provided in follow-up).

Proposed timeline:
- Today (16 Feb): internal review comments in-line
- 17 Feb: leadership alignment call if needed (15m)
- 18 Feb EOD: final sign-off and DocuSign send

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

----
Attachment stub: Q1_objective_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)
Attachment stub: owners-roadmap_v0_3.pdf (pdf, 480KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maria Gonzales <maria.g@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Owners' roadmap, QBR readiness and charter sign-off

Thanks Monica — quick read, looks solid. A couple of nits from my side:

- Revenue KR (KR1.1): we need to map the calendar weeks to quota periods; Sales Ops (TBD) should sign the final numbers. I'll volunteer Michelle Tran for sign-off but want to confirm with Ops first.
- KR2.3 (trial-to-paid conversion): suggest the target be stated as an absolute % and a baseline (current 6.8% -> target 9.0%).
- Risk: renewal window for a large customer (Acct X) overlaps our proposed launch. Call that out under "external timing risk".

If we can get Ops confirmation by EOD tomorrow, I'm comfortable routing this for sign-off on 18th. If not, we may need to push the DocuSign send until following Monday.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Owners' roadmap, QBR readiness and charter sign-off

Looping in a few runtime notes after a quick pass:

- KR3 (average tail latency): current baseline 95th pctl = 420ms on hosted routes; target 95th pctl = 320ms. That's aggressive given the current model mix. Recommend we add a sub-KR for "model variant fallbacks" to manage SLA exposure.
- Cost KR (per-token): include explicit batch-size targets per route — I'll coordinate with Runtime to get suggested values by EOD today.
- Dependency: SRE needs a 48hr window for a pre-launch soak on dedicated capacity if we plan to enable Private deployment in parallel. If we cannot secure that slot before Mar 1, we should mark the Private-related KRs as dependent.

I'll prepare a short change-pass and attach to the charter. If everyone agrees, I'll generate the consolidated owner table and add a column for "SRE launch sign-off" so we don't lose that check.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

Hi Monica — thanks for pulling this together. Quick answers from Acme side:

- Target launch: tentatively Mar 15 (internal procurement sign-off by Mar 5). Procurement asked for a standard PO and a countersigned commercial annex.
- Technical review: our infra team wants a short call to validate the dedicated capacity slots and the SRE soak window Vivek mentioned. Who should join from Redwood?
- DocuSign: procurement prefers DocuSign for countersignature. Please send when ready.

Happy to jump on a 20m call Thursday if that helps.

Best,
Maria Gonzales
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corporation
maria.g@acme.com

To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Maria Gonzales <maria.g@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Owners' roadmap, QBR readiness and charter sign-off

Thanks everyone — quick consolidation and final asks: 

Decisions agreed:
- Revenue KR1.1: Laura will confirm Sales Ops approver (Michelle Tran) by EOD Friday; quota mapping column added.
- Conversion KR2.3: baseline + absolute % target added as Laura requested.
- Runtime KRs: Vivek's recommendation to add a sub-KR for model-variant fallbacks accepted; added SRE launch sign-off column.
- Launch date: Acme targets Mar 15; procurement wants countersigned commercial annex (DocuSign).

Next steps (owners + deadlines):
- Monica: generate DocuSign envelope for commercial annex and send to Acme (will attach the final charter pages) — by 18 Feb EOD (sent).
- Laura: confirm Michelle Tran and provide Sales Ops sign-off or escalate to Ops by 19 Feb COB.
- Vivek: provide batch-size guidance and confirm SRE slot availability (48hr soak) by 19 Feb COB.
- Karthik: add a dependency tag in the charter for Private deployment and schedule a security review slot (tentative week of Mar 1).

I've attached the consolidated owner table (owners-roadmap_v0_3.pdf) and sent the DocuSign envelope for Acme. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcdef123456

Maria — please confirm receipt of the DocuSign email and whether procurement needs any additional documentation. If helpful, we can do the 20m call Thursday — suggest Vivek + one SRE + Monica.

Final sign-off will be recorded in the QBR packet once we have the countersigned commercial annex and Sales Ops approval.

Thanks again —
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
